description: Change the stacking order of page elements (updatePageElementsZOrder). Inserted images land on top of the stack and can cover overlay text — send them backward or to the back. All elements must be on the same page.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

operation.description: Z-order operation applied to the elements

pageElementObjectIds.description: Element object IDs to reorder (same page)

name: setElementZOrder
